description: Opaque cream floor-length court dress with low square neckline, naturally fitted bodice and elbow sleeves, restrained purple/gold woven borders at neckline, seams, cuffs and hem. Narrow purple/gold girdle with a round clasp, loose plum shoulder wrap resting along forearms, small pendant, modest drop earrings and bracelet, brown closed leather shoes. Bare head, no armor or weapons. Plain stone columns, steps and wooden doorway fill the background; no hanging banner, cloth emblem, fringe or attachment is visible.
